in_sanskrit.name: Saakethika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Protection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saakethika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Saakethika is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words Saaketha (protectress) and Ika (one). This name signifies the Goddess who protects and nurtures her devotees with unwavering devotion and strength. It is also believed to be a name of Lakshmi, the Goddess of Wealth, signifying her protective and nurturing nature.
